user.title: Alexa Shopping List Sync
user.description:
Sign in to your Amazon account. Use a secondary account for testing if possible.

**About the TOTP field**: this is the long **shared secret** (base32, like `JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP`) you got from the QR-code setup screen when you enrolled the authenticator — NOT the rotating 6-digit code. If you have it, paste it and you'll never see an MFA prompt again. If you don't, **leave it blank** — the next step will ask you for the current 6-digit code from your app.

data.otp_secret: TOTP shared secret — base32 string, NOT the 6-digit code (leave blank to enter the code each login)
